description: This file defines the code-behind for the Razor Page 'Index' in the eShopWeb project. It manages retrieving a catalog view model asynchronously using a service, with filtering and pagination support.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: The page model class for the Index Razor Page, responsible for handling page requests and loading catalog data.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the page, fetching catalog items asynchronously with optional pagination and filters.
